bounded_context_cards.title: Ending: The Canmore Settlement
bounded_context_cards.body: Dunfermline, Benedictine influence, new names, and new loyalties all point to a kingdom that is no longer simply Alba of the old chronicles. The house changes, the language changes, and the realm survives by changing with them.

bounded_context_cards.title: Ending: The Ashes of Dunsinane
bounded_context_cards.body: The crown passes through smoke and grief, and Lulach''s brief coronation cannot stop the return of Malcolm. The story ends in dynastic loss, but it also records how much history had to happen before Malcolm could inherit it.

bounded_context_cards.title: Ending: The Roman Pilgrimage
bounded_context_cards.body: The kingdom does not escape violence, but it does escape the cheap version of history that reduces Macbeth to a single murderous night. Alba remains a political kingdom with a ruler who understood that legitimacy had to be built in more than one register.

bounded_context_cards.title: Super Secret Ending: The Inverted Heath
bounded_context_cards.body: The heath has become a chamber inside the kingdom, and the kingdom a chamber inside the prophecy. Macbeth sees that rule was never only blood and law; it was also the shape of the place that held them. In this inversion, Alba does not simply fall into history. It answers the witches and becomes the riddle that outlives the throne.

bounded_context_cards.title: Act II: Crinan's Rising
bounded_context_cards.body: The uprising is personal, dynastic, and short. It proves that the old king's family still has reach, but not enough force to dislodge Macbeth once the new regime has hardened around him.

sample_options.text: Crush the revolt quickly and make the cost unmistakable. The court, the road, and the archive all remember it.
sample_reactions: The rebellion dies fast enough to remind the court that Macbeth is not merely holding the throne; he is willing to defend it. The next claim will remember it. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.
Crinan''s death turns private grievance into dynastic warning. The court will count the cost later. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.

sample_options.text: Offer terms to the old house and risk looking weak. The court, the road, and the archive all remember it.
sample_reactions: Mercy might quiet one feud, but it also tells every claimant that the kingdom can be tested. The next claim will remember it. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.
A generous king is only safe if his generosity is read as strength. The court will count the cost later. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.

sample_options.text: Turn the uprising into proof that Macbeth is defending Alba rather than merely taking it. The court, the road, and the archive all remember it.
sample_reactions: The king''s defenders now have a cleaner story to tell: Macbeth is the ruler who kept Alba intact when the old house fractured. The next claim will remember it. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.
Even the opposition has to admit that the revolt made the crown look more necessary, not less. The court will count the cost later. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.

bounded_context_cards.title: Act I: Pitgaveny
bounded_context_cards.body: This is the moment the chronicles remember as the hinge between legal kingship and actual power. Duncan's army is broken, the court hesitates, and Macbeth steps into a vacancy that no speech can repair.

sample_options.text: Move openly and seize the throne before Duncan's allies regroup. The court, the road, and the archive all remember it.
sample_reactions: The crown now belongs to whoever can occupy it, and Macbeth proves he can move faster than the surviving royal party. The next claim will remember it. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.
Duncan's death ends the argument for one claimant and begins the harder argument over legitimacy. The court will count the cost later. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.

sample_options.text: Let Gruoch and the Moray kin present the claim as continuity, not usurpation. The court, the road, and the archive all remember it.
sample_reactions: Gruoch gives the claim a family face, and the coup begins to look like restoration to those who benefit from it. The next claim will remember it. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.
The north hears not merely rebellion but a line of descent that can be narrated in public. The court will count the cost later. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.

sample_options.text: Stage the killing as justice for a failed king rather than a naked coup. The court, the road, and the archive all remember it.
sample_reactions: A justified death is still a death, but the framing matters long enough for the new reign to take root. The next claim will remember it. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.
The court has blood on its hands and a story in its mouth; both will matter. The court will count the cost later. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.

bounded_context_cards.title: Act III: Lulach Crowned at Scone
bounded_context_cards.body: The coronation is brief, fragile, and astonishingly important. It proves that the kingdom has not simply fallen into Malcolm's hands; it still contains another claim, another memory, and another attempt to keep the Moray line alive.

sample_options.text: Treat the coronation as the legitimate continuation of Macbeth''s line. The court, the road, and the archive all remember it.
sample_reactions: Lulach''s crown gives the defeated line one last public form. The next claim will remember it. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.
The ceremony matters precisely because it is the first of its kind in the record. The court will count the cost later. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.

sample_options.text: View Lulach as a stopgap and plan for Malcolm''s return. The court, the road, and the archive all remember it.
sample_reactions: A stopgap can still move history if it buys time for a new claimant to gather force. The next claim will remember it. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.
Malcolm''s return will test whether the kingdom remembers Scone or only the battlefield. The court will count the cost later. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.

sample_options.text: Use the ceremony at Scone to anchor the kingdom in ritual before war resumes. The court, the road, and the archive all remember it.
sample_reactions: Ritual can stabilize a kingdom for a moment, even when armies are already moving again. The next claim will remember it. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.
The coronation turns fragile succession into public memory. The court will count the cost later. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.

bounded_context_cards.title: Act III: Siward Crosses the Border
bounded_context_cards.body: Siward is the kind of figure the chronicles flatten into size: almost a giant in stature, and large enough politically to shift the balance of war. His intervention turns Macbeth's reign from internal consolidation to border crisis.

sample_options.text: Meet Siward in the field and force the issue immediately. The court, the road, and the archive all remember it.
sample_reactions: A direct fight promises clarity, but it also gives the English the battle they came for. The next claim will remember it. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.
Siward''s arrival means the northern war is no longer a private dynastic dispute. The court will count the cost later. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.

sample_options.text: Let Malcolm''s claim ride with the English host and expose the alliance as foreign-backed. The court, the road, and the archive all remember it.
sample_reactions: Malcolm''s claim becomes easier to describe and harder to dismiss once English steel is behind it. The next claim will remember it. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.
The court now has to decide whether the war is about succession or about the shape of Alba itself. The court will count the cost later. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.

sample_options.text: Seek to split the invaders by reminding Alba that not every lord welcomes English influence. The court, the road, and the archive all remember it.
sample_reactions: Division inside the realm is still useful, but only if the message reaches the men carrying spears. The next claim will remember it. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.
A kingdom in crisis can survive many things; a kingdom that forgets its own loyalties is in danger. The court will count the cost later. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.

bounded_context_cards.title: Act I: Malcolm II's Death
bounded_context_cards.body: The old house of Alpin closes with ceremony that cannot hide its instability. In Alba, blood, fosterage, and marriage now matter more than any single proclamation, and Macbeth is already watching how quickly a crown can become a target.

sample_options.text: Honor the Dunkeld line and crown Duncan at once. The court, the road, and the archive all remember it.
sample_reactions: The court prefers clarity, but clarity only exposes how young and exposed Duncan's reign will be. The next claim will remember it. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.
The law looks tidy for a moment, then the north begins to measure how long the new king can hold. The court will count the cost later. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.

sample_options.text: Test Macbeth's Moray claim through Gruoch and the older kinship ties. The court, the road, and the archive all remember it.
sample_reactions: Macbeth''s claim moves from rumor to politics, and the old order starts counting Moray as a real center of power. The next claim will remember it. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.
What looked like a side branch of the family now feels like the strongest current in the kingdom. The court will count the cost later. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.

sample_options.text: Hold the court together until every lord has spoken and every hostage is counted. The court, the road, and the archive all remember it.
sample_reactions: Delay may prevent one crisis, but it gives every faction time to sharpen its own story. The next claim will remember it. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.
A cautious court is still a divided court; the next move will belong to whoever can gather the broadest oath. The court will count the cost later. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.

sample_options.text: Crown Duncan and stabilize the old house. The court, the road, and the archive all remember it.
sample_reactions: The court gets a king, but not yet a settled peace. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.
The Dunkeld line holds, but the north keeps its own memory. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.

bounded_context_cards.title: Act II: The Roman Pilgrimage
bounded_context_cards.body: The pilgrimage is the quiet center of the storyworld. It places the king inside a larger moral geography, and it complicates any easy tale of barbarism by showing a ruler who can travel, negotiate, and return with authority intact.

sample_options.text: Let Rome validate the reign and strengthen the king at home. The court, the road, and the archive all remember it.
sample_reactions: Legitimacy arrives not only through battle but through recognition, and the court feels the difference. The next claim will remember it. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.
Rome turns Macbeth into a ruler who can speak to the wider Christian order, not just the local host. The court will count the cost later. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.

sample_options.text: Treat the journey as weakness and use the absence to organize rivals. The court, the road, and the archive all remember it.
sample_reactions: Absence creates room for rumor, and rumor is always eager to call a reign fragile. The next claim will remember it. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.
Any rival who moves during the king''s absence is gambling that ceremony is weaker than ambition. The court will count the cost later. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.

sample_options.text: Tie the pilgrimage to Alba''s prosperity so the court reads it as confidence. The court, the road, and the archive all remember it.
sample_reactions: A prosperous kingdom can afford a pilgrimage, and the court understands the message immediately. The next claim will remember it. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.
The journey becomes proof that Alba is stable enough to send its king away and have him return stronger. The court will count the cost later. In Alba, the record outlives the moment.
